subject: Reques for Help- Could not load package org.renjin:grid

messages.author: f5ba220c33f6a76c
messages.subject: Reques for Help- Could not load package org.renjin:grid
parts:
Hello,

I am new to Renjin.

I am trying  to load library 'lattice' and I got an error as 'Coluld not load package org.renjin:grid'. I don't see any grid in Renjin packages. Can you please guide me how to solve the problem.

My code is as below. 

try {
    Session mySession = new SessionBuilder()
            .withDefaultPackages()
            .build();


    // create a script engine manager:
    RenjinScriptEngineFactory factory = new RenjinScriptEngineFactory();
    // create a Renjin engine:
    ScriptEngine engine = factory.getScriptEngine(mySession);

    engine.eval("library(lattice)");

thanks,
srinibabu

messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: Reques for Help- Could not load package org.renjin:grid
parts:
Hi Srini Babu,

The grid package is part of Renjin itself. Normally, this dependency will be resolved automatically by your build tools, whether Maven or Ivy or SBT, etc., but if you are not using a build tool you will need to download it manually from the Renjin repo. Here is a link to the latest version:

https://nexus.bedatadriven.com/content/groups/public/org/renjin/grid/0.8.2417/

I would definitely recommend using a modern build tool. You can find documentation on using Renjin with various JVM-based build tools here:
http://docs.renjin.org/en/latest/library/project-setup.html

All the best,
Alex
